spec_match.rationale: Implements the exact §6.3 grammar (iamf.PPP.AAA.<substream>, 3-digit 0–255 profiles, the four substream codecs) as verified against Chromium's ParseIamfCodecId in media/base/audio_codecs.cc, and probes via the real MediaSource.isTypeSupported.

interactive.rationale: Profile inputs and substream select re-probe live on every change; five must-reject buttons feed genuinely malformed strings through the same probe path.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises an interactive composer with real verdicts including malformed strings; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Rejection cases cover wrong digit counts, out-of-range profiles, unlisted substreams, non-AAC-LC mp4a suffixes, and truncated strings — the probe demonstrably returns false.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5113656292540416 plus the IAMF spec, §6.3, explainer, web demo, and test stream.

conformance.rationale: Suite asserts both positive support (on enabled builds) and grammar rejections plus cross-probe agreement — the same contracts this workbench exercises.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: changed profile to 000/flac (live re-probe observed), clicked the 999-profile reject button (false verdict logged); zero console errors, 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: iamf-workbench-probe fires per probe and iamf-invalid-rejected asserts each must-reject string actually reports false.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; emerald/rose verdict values on stone background (AA); ≥44px inputs and buttons.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled number inputs and select; verdict line is role=status aria-live; probe log is role=log; reject buttons grouped with an aria-label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Two-panel bench collapses to one column under 720px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Verify positive verdicts on an IAMF-enabled build
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 (and any build without ENABLE_IAMF_TOOLS) reports false for all valid strings, so only the rejection half of the grammar could be positively confirmed. On a Chrome 152 build with --enable-features=IamfAudioDecoding, confirm valid strings flip to true while the must-reject buttons stay false.

guidanceConsulted.query: number input select live recompute accessible labels
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give every field a programmatic label and recompute on input/change without a submit step.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All three fields have <label for>; probes run on both input and change events.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout updates aria-live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce recomputed results via live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: MSE verdict is role=status aria-live; the probe log is role=log aria-live.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive two panel layout small screens no overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single-column collapse below a min width; wrap long strings.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: bench grid collapses under 720px; built string uses word-break; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): live composition, re-probe on change, and genuine rejection of malformed strings all confirmed on Chromium 141 with a clean console at both viewports. Positive support verdicts require an IAMF-enabled build and are recorded as an open question.
